sbh2.7:1.1: Printed *kauśalālambanaṁ (kauśalyālambanaṁ)*, the parenthesis Shukla’s correction (p. 237), both transcribed; Xuanzang has one term (善巧所緣, T1579 juan 27).
sbh2.7:2.4: Printed text omits *saṁjñāskandhaḥ* (Shukla p. 237), supplied in the Sanskrit as given here; Xuanzang has it (想蘊, T1579 juan 27).
sbh2.7:6.3: Printed *cetanāṁ*; read *vedanāṁ* (Xuanzang 除受及想, T1579 juan 27).
sbh2.7:7.2: Printed *cittaṁ manovijñānaṁ*; read *cittaṁ mano vijñānaṁ* (Xuanzang 心、意、識, T1579 juan 27; cf. sbh2.6:10.7).
sbh2.7:10.3: Printed *bhūtalaukika-*; read *bhūtabhautika-* (Xuanzang 大種所造, T1579 juan 27).
sbh2.7:12.14: Printed text omits *manodhātuḥ* (Shukla p. 245 n. 1); Xuanzang has it (意界, T1579 juan 27).
sbh2.7:17.1: Printed *abhiṣpandayanti … pariṣpandayanti*; read *abhiṣyandayanti … pariṣyandayanti* (Xuanzang 滋潤、等潤, T1579 juan 27).
sbh2.7:18.3: Printed *viṣamahetukatāṁ*; read *aviṣamahetukatāṁ* (Xuanzang 非不平等, T1579 juan 27).
sbh2.7:18.4: Printed text omits the wholesome half of the pair; Xuanzang has it (若諸善法能感可愛果異熟法, T1579 juan 27).
